text:
Lena: Massive shoutout to Omar and Jules for the 10pm supply run when the pantry ran dry before the big demo. You two are heroes. :sparkles:
Omar: LOL we sprinted like it was Black Friday. Ended up with flimsy carts and three types of hummus.
Jules: Also found the mystery box of caffeine shots in the server room closet. That was a score. :rocket:
Maya: I owe you both my demo survival. The last slide went smoother because no one was cranky from hunger.
People-Ops: Adding a team-level "Snack Responder" badge to the kudos digest. Also, does anyone want a permanent spare kit for late nights?
Lena: Yes please. Could we do a small stash under the 3rd floor kitchen cabinet? Ideally labeled 'Emergency Demo Fuel'.
Facilities: We can install a lockable snack box with a sign-in sheet. Also, reminder: do not store food in server closets unless explicitly approved. :clipboard:
Snack-Cart-Bot: Restock event: 2026-02-03T22:13:00Z - hummus, granola bars, assorted chips, 6 cold brew cans. Noted suppliers: Omar, Jules. :package:
Omar: Happy to lead a tiny rotation for restock runs for the next month. Whoever's on call that week chips in $10 to restock fund?
Jules: I'm in. Also, next time we will bring pita. Can't live without pita.
Maya: I volunteer to organize the fund collection and make a little chart so people can opt in.
Lena: Thank you all. Small kindnesses like this keep energy up. Coffee and a toast to the snack runners in the kitchen at 4pm! :coffee: :tada:
